environment.description: Same service deployed on ECS Fargate. The Split.io workspace has the feature flag 'enable_outbound_webhooks' configured with a default treatment of 'off' and a targeting rule that returns 'on' ONLY for user IDs matching the regex pattern '^internal-service-[a-f0-9]{8}$' which are programmatic service accounts. The flag's 'default rule' (catch-all for unmatched traffic) returns 'off'. The Split SDK is initialized with the impression listener that logs all evaluations. The flag definition was last modified 2024-01-15 and has change-lock enabled requiring two approvals in the Split UI to modify targeting rules.
